summary: Frontend regression for two reported P0 bugs: (Bug1) Bíblia 'Explicar com IA' insertBefore crash — VERIFIED FIXED. (Bug2) Aula iframe video not changing across aulas — Frontend code fix is correct (reactive keys + state reset), but actual cause is SEED DATA: ALL 21 aulas in Supabase have identical url_video ('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L_LUpnjgPso'). User-perceived 'same video' is a data problem, not a React rendering problem. Regression of highlight, favorite (Promessas/Estudos), observação pessoal, and other tabs (Início, Academia, Comunidade, Eventos) all OK.

data_issues.issue: All 21 aulas share the same url_video value 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L_LUpnjgPso'. As long as data is identical, the iframe will display the same video across aulas regardless of any front-end key/reset logic.
data_issues.evidence: Verified via Supabase REST GET /rest/v1/aulas with authenticated user — Counter shows count=21 for the same URL.
data_issues.suggested_fix: Update seed data so each aula has a distinct url_video (or run a migration script that assigns different YouTube IDs per aula). The frontend already remounts the iframe correctly when src changes (key={embed} on iframe + key={`video-${id}`} on parent + state reset on id change in Aula.jsx).

action_items: DATA FIX (HIGH): Update Supabase aulas table — assign distinct url_video values per aula (or per curso). Without this, the iframe will continue to look identical across aulas to the user.
Optional: add a one-off SQL migration in /app/scripts to UPDATE public.aulas SET url_video = ... per id with sample YouTube IDs.
critical_code_review_comments: Aula.jsx — fix is correct: useEffect resets aula+completed on id change, iframe has key={embed}, parent section has key={`video-${id}`}. Will work as soon as data differs.

Biblia.jsx — VerseExplanation extracted into its own component and wrapped with explanationKey for forced remount; this is a sound mitigation for the React reconciliation crash that previous testing reported.
Aula.jsx line 38-39: `setAula(null); setCompleted(false)` is correctly placed BEFORE the async fetch so the iframe unmounts during transition — good.
Both files keep keys reasonably; nothing else to flag.

Bug 2 is NOT a frontend issue — Supabase aulas table contains identical url_video for every aula (verified via REST). Once the main agent updates the seed data, retest with two aulas that have different url_video to confirm the iframe switches; the existing key={embed} logic should already work. rca of the issue.bug1: Previous testing reported 'Failed to execute insertBefore on Node' when toggling AI explanation inside the Drawer. RCA: rapid skeleton ↔ paragraph swap conflicted with Drawer's Vaul reconciliation (sibling text nodes). Mitigation applied by main agent: extracted VerseExplanation into its own component, wrapped it in a div with key={`explanation-slot-${explanationKey}`}, and added key on the drawer's scrolling content tied to selectedVerse.number. Verified: zero pageerrors across multiple verse+AI invocations.
rca of the issue.bug2: RCA: NOT a React rendering bug. All 21 rows in public.aulas have identical url_video. Even with perfect React keying, iframe will appear unchanged because the underlying data is identical. The fix-up belongs in the database, not in Aula.jsx. The frontend changes (state reset on id, key={embed} on iframe, key={`video-${id}`} on parent) are still beneficial defensively and will correctly differentiate when data differs.
